target: workflow.sh merge — a dangling end marker (no open region) exits 3 and writes nothing; the project file is byte-identical afterward
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/workflow-fixture.sh"; wf_file project.js '// stray end marker below' '// @agentic-loop:end region=ghost' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("hi");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet'; wf_file template.js '// @agentic-loop:begin region=greet owner=plugin' 'console.log("hi");' '// @agentic-loop:end region=greet'; cp project.js expected.js; workflow_merge project.js template.js '//' '{}' >/dev/null 2>merge.err; MERGE_EXIT=$?; MATCH=$(cmp -s project.js expected.js && echo true || echo false); jq -n --argjson exitcode $MERGE_EXIT --argjson m "$MATCH" --arg err "$(cat merge.err)" '{exit:$exitcode, match:$m, stderr:$err}'; exit "$MERGE_EXIT"
_note: A dangling `end` (no matching `begin`) must abort before touching disk. Checks both the harness-observed exit code (via the trailing `exit "$MERGE_EXIT"`) and the captured merge exit status, plus a byte-exact cmp against a pre-call copy — 'writes nothing' is the safety property, not just the nonzero exit.
